facts.fact: Committee co-chair Mothusi Tladi says the ICT Sector Sub High Level Consultative Committee on 9 June 2026 was briefed on the AI Policy and its path to Cabinet approval.

BWA.note: Only an update on a Cybersecurity Act is mentioned; whether it is a bill or in force is not stated.
1Gov and the Digital Services Act are named as agenda items with no service or portal described.
Nothing on a data sharing law.

facts.fact: The ICT Sector Sub High Level Consultative Committee, co-chaired by the Minister of Communications and Innovation, sat on 9 June 2026 with private sector presenters (including BITS and COBIT, the latter on feedback on government online services) beside BOCRA and ministry updates, its first sitting under this administration in over two years.
